_title: Workplace layer: De Wilgenboom on Cunningham
_note: What you see: The workplace tokens of De Wilgenboom on Cunningham: colours, status colours, the states in the register, shapes, the today first card and typography.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De werkplek-tokens van De Wilgenboom op Cunningham: kleuren, statuskleuren, de stand in het register, vormen, de kaart vandaag eerst en typografie.
Werkplek-laag: De Wilgenboom op Cunningh: Workplace layer: De Wilgenboom on Cunningham
Voor het team gebruikt thematiq de Cunni: For the team thematiq uses the Cunningham components (La Suite) with the tokens of De Wilgenboom. Light and calm, because a teacher looks at this between two lessons. Colour means something: green is an action, yellow is your place in the menu or something new, red is only for what really needs attention.
Zachte vlakken met donkere tekst. Elke t: Soft surfaces with dark text. Every text reaches at least 4,5 : 1. The status is always written in words as well.
Vier standen, elk met een eigen teken, z: Four states, each with its own symbol, so you tell them apart without colour too.
Knoppen 8, kaarten 12: de schaal van Nex: Buttons 8, cards 12: the Nextcloud scale, so built-in apps match. The website for parents is slightly rounder (10 and 14). Shadow only on cards: 0 1px 2px, 4% ink.
Het register van vandaag is nog niet ing: Today's register has not been filled in yet
Eén kaart per scherm mag zo opvallen: ee: One card per screen may stand out like this: a yellow surface, no coloured border.
Focus: 2 px groene rand, altijd zichtbaa: Focus: 2 px green border, always visible.
Actief: donkergeel op zachtgeel, 7,3 : 1: Active: dark yellow on soft yellow, 7,3 : 1
